features.name: fn.type_ec
features.description: 1 if the function is an EC number

features.name: fn.type_go
features.description: 1 if the function is a GO term

features.name: fn.type_other
features.description: 1 for any other function namespace (KEGG, COG, AMR, ...)

features.name: fn.go_aspect_mf

features.name: fn.go_aspect_bp

features.name: fn.go_aspect_cc

features.name: fn.go_aspect_unknown

features.name: fn.in_complex_term

features.name: fn.complex_heteromeric

features.name: fn.complex_ambiguous
features.description: 1 if that complex term is classified ambiguous (a): neither homomeric nor heteromeric is asserted

features.name: role.unspecified

features.name: seq.n_sources_reporting
features.description: number of distinct sources reporting this function (not number of hits)

features.name: seq.n_groups_reporting
features.description: number of distinct evidence groups reporting this function

features.name: seq.max_raw_any
features.description: strongest raw score over all baseline sequence claims

features.name: seq.best_pident_available
features.description: 1 if any claim carries a percent-identity metadata value

features.name: seq.best_pident
features.description: best percent identity / 100 over claims carrying it (0 if unavailable)

features.name: seq.cov.status_available
features.description: 1 if predictor completion statuses were supplied

features.name: seq.cov.n_sources_not_fully_run
features.description: number of predictors with outcome FAILED, UNAVAILABLE or PARTIAL (absence from them is uninformative); 0 if statuses not supplied

features.name: seq.cov.n_sources_ran_clean
features.description: number of predictors with outcome SUCCESS or SUCCESS_ZERO; 0 if statuses not supplied

features.name: ctx.operon.available
features.description: 1 if operon calls were supplied (state.operons non-empty)

features.name: ctx.operon.member
features.description: 1 if the protein is in a called operon

features.name: ctx.operon.log_size
features.description: log(1 + number of genes in the protein's operon); 0 if not a member

features.name: ctx.operon.n_members_with_seq_support
features.description: other operon members with any baseline sequence claim of any function

features.name: ctx.operon.n_members_dark
features.description: other operon members with no claim at all

features.name: ctx.layout.available
features.description: 1 if gene coordinates (state.genomeLayout) are available

features.name: ctx.layout.n_neighbors_10kb
features.description: other genes within +-10 kb (midpoint) on the same contig

features.name: ctx.layout.same_strand_fraction
features.description: fraction of those neighbours on the candidate's strand (0 if none)

features.name: ctx.competitor.max_raw
features.description: strongest raw baseline score for the SAME function on another local protein (same operon or +-10 kb); paralog/decoy signal

features.name: ctx.competitor.n_with_claim
features.description: number of other local proteins with any claim for the same function

features.name: ctx.gap.available
features.description: 1 if metabolic gaps were supplied (state.metabolicGaps non-empty)

features.name: ctx.gap.function_listed
features.description: 1 if an open (not already closed) metabolic gap lists this EC/GO function; a listing indicator, NOT a Bayes factor

features.name: ctx.gap.gapseq_guessed_listed
features.description: 1 if such a gap was one for which gapseq itself proposed a gene (a different, weaker kind of listing)

features.name: ctx.nbr.available
features.description: 1 if structured neighbourhood features were supplied for this candidate

features.name: ctx.nbr.support_max
features.description: supplied: strongest raw baseline support among neighbours for functions in the candidate's reaction/pathway neighbourhood

features.name: ctx.nbr.n_supporting
features.description: supplied: number of neighbours with such support

features.name: ctx.nbr.conflict_max
features.description: supplied: strongest raw support among neighbours for a function incompatible with the candidate (unfavourable context)

features.name: ctx.nbr.reaction_distance_available
features.description: 1 if a reaction-graph distance was supplied

features.name: ctx.nbr.reaction_distance
features.description: supplied: reaction-graph distance to the nearest supported neighbour reaction (0 if unavailable)

features.name: cohort.available
features.description: 1 if cohort recurrence was supplied for this candidate

features.name: cohort.log_n_genomes
features.description: log(1 + genomes in the cohort); a count, never normalised to certainty

features.name: cohort.frac_with_orthogroup
features.description: fraction of cohort genomes with the candidate's orthogroup (0 if unavailable)

features.name: cohort.frac_with_function_seq
features.description: fraction of those with baseline sequence support for the function (not posteriors)

features.name: cohort.frac_with_context
features.description: fraction of those where the function is also supported by neighbourhood context

features.name: cohort.n_genomes_incomplete
features.description: supplied count of cohort genomes with incomplete assembly (absence uninformative)

features.name: cohort.w.available
features.description: 1 if a joint (phylogeny-weighted, background-matched) cohort analysis supplied features for this candidate

features.name: cohort.w.states_available
features.description: 1 if the 'states' feature group (fracSupported) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.support_raw_available
features.description: 1 if the 'support_raw' feature group (supportFractionRaw) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.interval_available
features.description: 1 if the 'interval' feature group (supportFractionLo90) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.unknown_sens_available
features.description: 1 if the 'unknown_sens' feature group (supportUnknownAsNegative) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.bg_available
features.description: 1 if the 'bg' feature group (bgRate) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.complementary_available
features.description: 1 if the 'complementary' feature group (complementarity) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.perm_available
features.description: 1 if the 'perm' feature group (permP) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.multicopy_available
features.description: 1 if the 'multicopy' feature group (multicopyFraction) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.organism_rxn_available
features.description: 1 if the 'organism_rxn' feature group (peerReactionInOrganismFraction) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.local_available
features.description: 1 if the 'local' feature group (localAnchorCount) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.local_enrich_available
features.description: 1 if the 'local_enrich' feature group (localEnrichmentLog) was computed for this candidate; its values are 0 otherwise

features.name: cohort.w.insufficient_peers
features.description: peers exist but none was informative (effective N is 0)

features.name: cohort.w.adjusted_available
features.description: clade/strain-adjusted outputs exist (metadata known); 0 = intervals and permutation p are withheld

features.name: cohort.w.layout_available
features.description: gene layout of the candidate genome was available to the cohort engine

features.name: cohort.w.ec_direct
features.description: the candidate arose from a direct EC -> reaction expansion (no EC -> GO step)

features.name: cohort.w.family_known
features.description: the protein has a family assignment

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence_missing
features.description: no protein-intrinsic role evidence at all (missing, NOT non-catalytic)

features.name: cohort.w.effective_n
features.description: log(1 + effective N): summed weight of informative independent clade/strain units

features.name: cohort.w.phylogeny_known_fraction
features.description: share of the peer set with real clade/strain metadata (1 = all known; unknown never counts as independent)

features.name: cohort.w.n_peer_genomes
features.description: log(1 + peer genomes after holding out the target and its non-independent relatives)

features.name: cohort.w.coverage
features.description: share of peer clades that were informative

features.name: cohort.w.support_fraction
features.description: weighted Jeffreys-smoothed share of informative peers whose family member sits in a context-positive window

features.name: cohort.w.peer_organism_set_known_fraction
features.description: share of peers with a known organism-specific reaction set

features.name: cohort.w.membership_weight
features.description: soft family membership weight of the candidate protein

features.name: cohort.w.n_family_alternatives
features.description: log(1 + further family assignments of the protein); paralog/subfamily ambiguity

features.name: cohort.w.n_reaction_alternatives
features.description: log(1 + further reaction hypotheses of the protein); alternatives are reported, not summed

features.name: cohort.w.ec_reaction_count
features.description: log(1 + reactions the supporting EC call maps to); 0 when the candidate did not come from a direct EC call

features.name: cohort.w.frac_supported
features.description: weighted share of peers: family member in a context-positive window [group states]

features.name: cohort.w.frac_negative
features.description: weighted share of peers: family present, fully observed windows lack the signature [group states]

features.name: cohort.w.frac_unknown_context
features.description: weighted share of peers: family present but the window is cut or of unknown extent [group states]

features.name: cohort.w.frac_true_absent
features.description: weighted share of peers where absence is certified (complete assembly AND all-protein family search) [group states]

features.name: cohort.w.frac_unobserved_absent
features.description: weighted share of peers with no member but absence NOT certified (unknown, not absence) [group states]

features.name: cohort.w.frac_pathway_without_family
features.description: weighted share of certified-absent peers that carry the pathway elsewhere [group states]

features.name: cohort.w.support_fraction_raw
features.description: unsmoothed weighted support fraction among informative peers [group support_raw]

features.name: cohort.w.support_unknown_as_negative
features.description: support fraction if unknown-context windows were negative [group unknown_sens]

features.name: cohort.w.support_unknown_as_support
features.description: support fraction if unknown-context windows were support [group unknown_sens]

features.name: cohort.w.support_fraction_lo90
features.description: approximate 90% lower bound on the support fraction (only with clade metadata) [group interval]

features.name: cohort.w.support_fraction_hi90
features.description: approximate 90% upper bound on the support fraction (only with clade metadata) [group interval]

features.name: cohort.w.bg_rate
features.description: rate of the signature in matched same-genome background windows (never total genome presence) [group bg]

features.name: cohort.w.bg_windows
features.description: log(1 + matched background windows) [group bg]

features.name: cohort.w.enrichment_log
features.description: log ratio of support to matched background [group bg]

features.name: cohort.w.support_minus_bg
features.description: support fraction minus matched background rate [group bg]

features.name: cohort.w.complementarity
features.description: joint minus mean single coverage of the reaction signature across independent lineages [group complementary]

features.name: cohort.w.complementary_unannotated
features.description: weighted share of signature reactions with no confident baseline candidate in a peer; UNANNOTATED label only, never evidence of loss [group complementary]

features.name: cohort.w.joint_coverage
features.description: share of signature reactions jointly covered by independent units next to the family [group complementary]

features.name: cohort.w.perm_p
features.description: add-one permutation p of the support statistic against matched windows (only with clade metadata) [group perm]

features.name: cohort.w.perm_excess
features.description: observed minus permutation-null mean of the support statistic [group perm]

features.name: cohort.w.multicopy_fraction
features.description: weighted share of informative peers with several family members (only with certified family search) [group multicopy]

features.name: cohort.w.peer_reaction_in_organism_fraction
features.description: weighted share of peers whose own plausible reaction set contains the reaction [group organism_rxn]

features.name: cohort.w.local_anchor_weight
features.description: sum of hop-decayed baseline confidences of anchor reactions in the candidate window [group local]

features.name: cohort.w.local_anchor_count
features.description: log(1 + distinct anchor reactions in the candidate window) [group local]

features.name: cohort.w.local_anchor_curated
features.description: log(1 + anchors linked through curated interaction edges) [group local]

features.name: cohort.w.local_anchor_upstream
features.description: log(1 + upstream anchors, respecting reaction direction) [group local]

features.name: cohort.w.local_anchor_downstream
features.description: log(1 + downstream anchors, respecting reaction direction) [group local]

features.name: cohort.w.local_context_positive
features.description: candidate window is context-positive (enough anchors) [group local]

features.name: cohort.w.local_window_truncated
features.description: candidate window is cut by a known contig end [group local]

features.name: cohort.w.local_window_unknown
features.description: candidate window extent is unknown [group local]

features.name: cohort.w.local_enrichment_log
features.description: log ratio of the window signature to matched same-genome windows [group local_enrich]

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.catalytic
features.description: raw protein-intrinsic CATALYTIC evidence in [0,1] (0 if not reported)

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.catalytic_reported
features.description: 1 if raw CATALYTIC evidence was reported for this protein

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.accessory
features.description: raw protein-intrinsic ACCESSORY evidence in [0,1] (0 if not reported)

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.accessory_reported
features.description: 1 if raw ACCESSORY evidence was reported for this protein

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.transporter
features.description: raw protein-intrinsic TRANSPORTER evidence in [0,1] (0 if not reported)

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.transporter_reported
features.description: 1 if raw TRANSPORTER evidence was reported for this protein

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.regulator
features.description: raw protein-intrinsic REGULATOR evidence in [0,1] (0 if not reported)

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.regulator_reported
features.description: 1 if raw REGULATOR evidence was reported for this protein

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.complex_subunit
features.description: raw protein-intrinsic COMPLEX_SUBUNIT evidence in [0,1] (0 if not reported)

features.name: cohort.w.role_evidence.complex_subunit_reported
features.description: 1 if raw COMPLEX_SUBUNIT evidence was reported for this protein

features.name: asm.available
features.description: 1 if the genome, the protein's contig sequence and valid CDS coordinates are available; the four asm.* values below are 0 otherwise

features.name: asm.log_contig_length
features.description: log(1 + length) of the protein's contig

features.name: asm.log_distance_to_contig_end
features.description: log(1 + bp from the CDS to the nearest contig end); small = truncation risk

features.name: asm.n_contigs
features.description: log(1 + number of contigs): fragmentation

features.name: asm.log_n50
features.description: log(1 + N50) of the assembly

features.name: asm.completeness_available
features.description: 1 if an external completeness estimate (e.g. CheckM2) was supplied

features.name: asm.completeness
features.description: supplied completeness / 100 (0 if unavailable)

features.name: fba.available
features.description: 1 if conditional FBA features were supplied and usable for this candidate

features.name: fba.suppressed_objective_forced
features.description: 1 if the tested objective itself required the candidate, so its FBA values were NOT used as evidence

features.name: fba.n_conditions
features.description: log(1 + number of media/objective conditions tested)

features.name: fba.required_fraction
features.description: fraction of tested conditions in which the candidate's model reaction carried REQUIRED flux, or its knockout removed or reduced growth (conditional on those conditions and on the model; conditions whose objective requires the candidate are excluded)

features.name: fba.optional_fraction_available
features.description: 1 if the share of tested conditions with optional (non-required) flux was reported

features.name: fba.optional_fraction
features.description: fraction of tested conditions in which the reaction could carry flux but was not required (conditional on those conditions; 0 if unavailable)

features.name: fba.knockout_growth_effect
features.description: supplied relative growth change on knockout (conditional; sign preserved)
